eyebrow: AWS: group membership vs. direct policy attachment
code:
group_members_aws = iam.get_group(GroupName="scada-ot-admins")["Users"]

direct_users_aws = []
for page in iam.get_paginator("list_entities_for_policy").paginate(
    PolicyArn="arn:aws:iam::222233334444:policy/SCADA-Emergency-Access",
    EntityFilter="User",
):
    direct_users_aws.extend(page["PolicyUsers"])
caption: list_entities_for_policy returns only direct attachments -- group-based access doesn't show up here at all.
